verdict.rationale: Devin has a first-party API reference that explicitly supports integrating Devin into applications and automating workflows, including documented session creation via a create_as_user_id parameter. The llms.txt index lists an API section, so the API documentation appears substantial. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), detailed endpoint coverage evidence beyond the overview, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving Devin through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Devin API enables you to integrate Devin into your applications, automate workflows, and build powerful tools.
you can create sessions on behalf of any user in your organization using the create_as_user_id parameter
